title: Vela companion registration v1
description: What a desktop app running on the same computer as Vela writes to Vela's companions folder so Vela can find it. The app keeps its own window and process; Vela reads its widget summaries and runs its declared actions over a loopback HTTP endpoint, and only after the owner connects it. See docs/COMPANIONS.md.

companion.description: Registration format version. A host that does not know a version ignores the file rather than guessing.

id.description: Stable identity. Also the registration file's name: <id>.json.

icon.description: A PNG file in the same companions folder, named by file name only. No paths: the host never reads outside that folder.

endpoint.description: Loopback only. The host refuses anything that is not this computer.

token.description: Random per start. The host sends it as a bearer credential on every request, so the app can refuse any other local caller.

pid.description: The process that wrote the file. A file whose process is gone describes an app that is not running.

executable.description: Absolute path of the program, shown when the owner connects it and used to start it again. Changing it needs the owner's review.

confirm.description: When present, the host asks this question before running the action.
